import CategoryTheory.Limits
import CategoryTheory.Presieve
import CategoryTheory.PreZeroHypercover
import CategoryTheory.Sheaf

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {S : C} (E : CategoryTheory.PreZeroHypercover S) [E.HasPullbacks] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type u_2)) : Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit (E.toPreOneHypercover.multifork F)) ↔ CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheafFor F E.presieve₀ := by
  constructor
  · intro hsheaf
    haveI : IsSheafFor F E.presieve₀ := hsheaf
    let p : Presieve := E.presieve₀
    let U : Set C := p.underlying
    let f : U → Type u_2 := λ X, F.obj (op X)
    let F' : Presheaf C (Type u_2) := Presheaf.mk f
    let F'' : Presheaf C (Type u_2) := F'
    let H : Hypercover := E.toPreOneHypercover
    let D : Diagram (Type u_2) := H.multifork F''
    let limit : MaybeLimit D := maybeLimitOfIsSheaf F''
    cases limit with l hl
    exact ⟨hl⟩
  · intro hlimit
    haveI : Nonempty (IsLimit (E.toPreOneHypercover.multifork F)) := hlimit
    let p : Presieve := E.presieve₀
    let U : Set C := p.underlying
    let f : U → Type u_2 := λ X, F.obj (op X)
    let F' : Presheaf C (Type u_2) := Presheaf.mk f
    let F'' : Presheaf C (Type u_2) := F'
    let H : Hypercover := E.toPreOneHypercover
    let D : Diagram (Type u_2) := H.multifork F''
    let limit : MaybeLimit D := maybeLimitOfNonemptyIsLimit hlimit
    cases limit with l hl
    exact IsSheafFor.ofMaybeLimit F'' l
